rule.title: Page Object Model (POM) for E2E Test Isolation
rule.statement: Playwright end-to-end tests must encapsulate web page locators and user interactions within Page Object Model (POM) classes.
rule.rationale: Directly hardcoding CSS selectors across dozens of test specs causes widespread test suite breakages whenever UI class names or layouts change.
rule.implementation_guidance: Create LoginPage, ChatPage, and DocumentPage classes with semantic action methods (e.g. login(email, pass)).

forbidden.example: await page.click('div.flex > div > input.sc-12'); await page.click('button.bg-blue-500');

preferred.example: await chatPage.sendMessage('What is the policy?'); expect(await chatPage.getAnswer()).toContain('Policy');

source.evidence_quote: Page Object Models reduce duplication and isolate test code from volatile UI structure. Tests interact with the page through meaningful business methods.

rule.title: Automated E2E Verification of the Critical RAG Journey
rule.statement: The CI quality gate must execute automated Playwright E2E tests verifying the core end-to-end journey: Login -> Document Upload -> Processing -> Chat Response with Citation.
rule.rationale: Unit tests and isolated API tests cannot detect browser rendering bugs, streaming connection drops, or CORS cookie authentication failures in production.
rule.implementation_guidance: Run Playwright against a staging environment before releasing to production.

forbidden.example: Deploying to production relying purely on unit tests with no browser integration check.

preferred.example: test('complete user journey: upload doc and ask question with citation', async ({ page }) => { ... });

source.evidence_quote: End-to-end testing must focus on high-value user journeys. Validating the core workflow from start to finish ensures critical business functionality remains operational.
